name: ynab-simplefin-sync
blurb: Provisions the sync into your own GitHub account. Credentials are sealed in your browser.
about: A CLI, published on npm, that reconciles YNAB account balances against SimpleFIN Bridge — it fetches what each account is actually worth and posts a single balance adjustment per account. Guided setup, dry-run previews, and CI-tested. Or skip the CLI: the hosted app installs a GitHub App onto one repository you pick — it asks for no administration scope, so you create the repo and it touches nothing else — then provisions the scheduled sync there, with credentials sealed in your browser and written straight to that repo's encrypted secrets.
